data.one_liner: A Dart type for precise financial values with exactly four decimal places.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Currency class that stores amounts as integers to avoid floating‑point rounding errors. Supports arithmetic, comparison and parsing from numbers or strings, handling very large values accurately.
use_when: Need exact financial calculations without rounding errors
Working with large monetary values that exceed double precision
avoid_when: Require locale‑aware currency formatting or variable fractional digits
Performance‑critical code where custom numeric types add overhead
strengths: Simple API for arithmetic and parsing
weaknesses: Fixed to four fractional digits only
No built‑in formatting or locale support
